measures.name: Distinct Contact Dates
Calls / Shift / hr
measures.expression:
VAR GlobalMinDate = CALCULATE(MIN(Data[Reporting Date]), ALLSELECTED(Data))
VAR GlobalMaxDate = CALCULATE(MAX(Data[Reporting Date]), ALLSELECTED(Data))
VAR SelectedDays = VALUES('Day of Week Filter'[Day Number])

VAR AllDates = CALENDAR(GlobalMinDate, GlobalMaxDate)
VAR PeriodWorkingDays = 
    COUNTROWS(
        FILTER(
            AllDates,
            VAR DayNum = WEEKDAY([Date], 1)
            RETURN DayNum IN SelectedDays
        )
    )

RETURN
SWITCH(
    TRUE(),
    
    // Customer Name level
    NOT ISBLANK(SELECTEDVALUE(Data[Customer Name])),
        VAR CustomerCalls = COUNT(Data[Contact ID])
        VAR CurrentCustomer = SELECTEDVALUE(Data[Customer Name])
        // Get customer's FIRST DATE EVER with more explicit filtering
        VAR CustomerFirstEverDate = 
            CALCULATE(
                MIN(Data[Reporting Date]),
                ALL(Data),
                Data[Customer Name] = CurrentCustomer
            )
        // If customer started after period began, use their start date
        VAR CustomerStartDate = MAX(CustomerFirstEverDate, GlobalMinDate)
        VAR CustomerDates = CALENDAR(CustomerStartDate, GlobalMaxDate)
        VAR CustomerWorkingDays = 
            COUNTROWS(
                FILTER(
                    CustomerDates,
                    VAR DayNum = WEEKDAY([Date], 1)
                    RETURN DayNum IN SelectedDays
                )
            )
        VAR RawValue = DIVIDE(CustomerCalls, CustomerWorkingDays, 0)
        RETURN ROUND(RawValue, 1),
    
    // Team level: SUM of customer values
    CALCULATE(
        SUMX(
            VALUES(Data[Customer Name]),
            VAR CustomerCalls = CALCULATE(COUNT(Data[Contact ID]))
            VAR CurrentCustomer = Data[Customer Name]
            VAR CustomerFirstEverDate = 
                CALCULATE(
                    MIN(Data[Reporting Date]),
                    ALL(Data),
                    Data[Customer Name] = CurrentCustomer
                )
            VAR CustomerStartDate = MAX(CustomerFirstEverDate, GlobalMinDate)
            VAR CustomerDates = CALENDAR(CustomerStartDate, GlobalMaxDate)
            VAR CustomerWorkingDays = 
                COUNTROWS(
                    FILTER(
                        CustomerDates,
                        VAR DayNum = WEEKDAY([Date], 1)
                        RETURN DayNum IN SelectedDays
                    )
                )
            VAR RawValue = DIVIDE(CustomerCalls, CustomerWorkingDays, 0)
            RETURN ROUND(RawValue, 1)
        ),
        ALLSELECTED(Data[Hour])
    )
)

measures.name: Recommended Nurses / Hour
measures.expression:
VAR IsCell =
    ISINSCOPE('Data'[Team]) && ISINSCOPE('Data'[Hour])
VAR IsRowSubtotal =
    ISINSCOPE('Data'[Team]) && NOT ISINSCOPE('Data'[Hour])
VAR IsColSubtotal =
    NOT ISINSCOPE('Data'[Team]) && ISINSCOPE('Data'[Hour])
RETURN
SWITCH(
    TRUE(),
    /* Body cells */
    IsCell,
        VAR AvgContacts = [Calls / Shift / hr]
        VAR CurrentTeam = SELECTEDVALUE('Data'[Team])
        VAR Divisor = 
            SWITCH(
                TRUE(),
                CurrentTeam = "MTI", 6,
                CurrentTeam = "WD", 6,
                RIGHT(CurrentTeam, 1) = "I", 6,
                RIGHT(CurrentTeam, 2) = "11", 6,
                CONTAINSSTRING(CurrentTeam, "NAL"), 4,
                5  -- Default for all other teams
            )
        VAR CalcResult = AvgContacts / Divisor
        VAR Result =
            IF(
                ISBLANK(AvgContacts),
                BLANK(),
                IF( CalcResult < 1, 1, ROUND( CalcResult, 0 ) )
            )
        RETURN Result,
    /* Row subtotal: Team × visible Hours */
    IsRowSubtotal,
        SUMX(
            VALUES('Data'[Hour]),
            VAR AvgContacts = [Calls / Shift / hr]
            VAR CurrentTeam = SELECTEDVALUE('Data'[Team])
            VAR Divisor = 
                SWITCH(
                    TRUE(),
                    CurrentTeam = "MTI", 6,
                    CurrentTeam = "WD", 6,
                    RIGHT(CurrentTeam, 1) = "I", 6,
                    RIGHT(CurrentTeam, 2) = "11", 6,
                    CONTAINSSTRING(CurrentTeam, "NAL"), 4,
                    5
                )
            VAR CalcResult = AvgContacts / Divisor
            VAR RowResult =
                IF(
                    ISBLANK(AvgContacts),
                    BLANK(),
                    IF( CalcResult < 1, 1, ROUND( CalcResult, 0 ) )
                )
            RETURN RowResult
        ),
    /* Column subtotal: Hour × visible Teams */
    IsColSubtotal,
        SUMX(
            VALUES('Data'[Team]),
            VAR CurrentTeam = 'Data'[Team]
            VAR AvgContacts = CALCULATE([Calls / Shift / hr])
            VAR Divisor = 
                SWITCH(
                    TRUE(),
                    CurrentTeam = "MTI", 6,
                    CurrentTeam = "WD", 6,
                    RIGHT(CurrentTeam, 1) = "I", 6,
                    RIGHT(CurrentTeam, 2) = "11", 6,
                    CONTAINSSTRING(CurrentTeam, "NAL"), 4,
                    5
                )
            VAR CalcResult = AvgContacts / Divisor
            VAR ColResult =
                IF(
                    ISBLANK(AvgContacts),
                    BLANK(),
                    IF( CalcResult < 1, 1, ROUND( CalcResult, 0 ) )
                )
            RETURN ColResult
        ),
    /* Grand total: sum Team × Hour cells */
    SUMX(
        CROSSJOIN( VALUES('Data'[Team]), VALUES('Data'[Hour]) ),
        VAR CurrentTeam = CALCULATE(MAX('Data'[Team]))
        VAR AvgContacts = CALCULATE([Calls / Shift / hr])
        VAR Divisor = 
            SWITCH(
                TRUE(),
                CurrentTeam = "MTI", 6,
                CurrentTeam = "WD", 6,
                RIGHT(CurrentTeam, 1) = "I", 6,
                RIGHT(CurrentTeam, 2) = "11", 6,
                CONTAINSSTRING(CurrentTeam, "NAL"), 4,
                5
            )
        VAR CalcResult = AvgContacts / Divisor
        VAR GrandResult =
            IF(
                ISBLANK(AvgContacts),
                BLANK(),
                IF( CalcResult < 1, 1, ROUND( CalcResult, 0 ) )
            )
        RETURN GrandResult
    )
)

measures.name: Date Range (Shown)
measures.expression:
VAR MinD =
    CALCULATE ( MIN ( 'Data'[Reporting Date] ), ALLSELECTED ( 'Data' ) )
VAR MaxD =
    CALCULATE ( MAX ( 'Data'[Reporting Date] ), ALLSELECTED ( 'Data' ) )
RETURN
IF (
    ISBLANK ( MinD ) || ISBLANK ( MaxD ),
    "No data",
    IF (
        MinD = MaxD,
        FORMAT ( MinD, "[$-en-US]mm/dd/yy" ),
        FORMAT ( MinD, "[$-en-US]mm/dd/yy" ) & " – " &
        FORMAT ( MaxD, "[$-en-US]mm/dd/yy" )
    )
)

measures.name: Avg Distinct Nurses (rounded)
measures.expression:
VAR GlobalMinDate = CALCULATE(MIN(Data[Reporting Date]), ALLSELECTED(Data))
VAR GlobalMaxDate = CALCULATE(MAX(Data[Reporting Date]), ALLSELECTED(Data))
VAR AllDates = CALENDAR(GlobalMinDate, GlobalMaxDate)
VAR SelectedDays = VALUES('Day of Week Filter'[Day Number])
VAR FilteredDates = 
    FILTER(
        AllDates,
        VAR CurrentDayNumber = WEEKDAY([Date], 1)
        RETURN CurrentDayNumber IN SelectedDays
    )

VAR CurrentHour = SELECTEDVALUE(Data[Hour])
VAR CurrentTeam = SELECTEDVALUE(Data[Team])

RETURN
SWITCH(
    TRUE(),
    
    // Team level - weighted allocation by call volume (including ROQ)
    NOT ISBLANK(CurrentTeam),
        ROUND(
            AVERAGEX(
                FilteredDates,
                VAR CurrentDate = [Date]
                VAR WeightedNurses = 
                    SUMX(
                        FILTER(
                            ALL(Data[Contact Agent Name]),
                            CALCULATE(
                                COUNT(Data[Contact ID]),
                                Data[Reporting Date] = CurrentDate,
                                Data[Hour] = CurrentHour,
                                Data[Team] = CurrentTeam
                            ) > 0
                        ),
                        VAR CurrentNurse = Data[Contact Agent Name]
                        VAR NurseCallsThisTeam = 
                            CALCULATE(
                                COUNT(Data[Contact ID]),
                                Data[Contact Agent Name] = CurrentNurse,
                                Data[Reporting Date] = CurrentDate,
                                Data[Hour] = CurrentHour,
                                Data[Team] = CurrentTeam,
                                ALL(Data[Team])
                            )
                        VAR NurseCallsAllTeams = 
                            CALCULATE(
                                COUNT(Data[Contact ID]),
                                Data[Contact Agent Name] = CurrentNurse,
                                Data[Reporting Date] = CurrentDate,
                                Data[Hour] = CurrentHour,
                                ALL(Data[Team])
                            )
                        RETURN DIVIDE(NurseCallsThisTeam, NurseCallsAllTeams, 0)
                    )
                RETURN WeightedNurses + 0
            ),
            1
        ),
    
    // Grand Total - simple distinct count (including ROQ)
    ROUND(
        AVERAGEX(
            FilteredDates,
            VAR CurrentDate = [Date]
            VAR NurseCount = 
                CALCULATE(
                    DISTINCTCOUNT(Data[Contact Agent Name]),
                    Data[Reporting Date] = CurrentDate,
                    Data[Hour] = CurrentHour
                )
            RETURN NurseCount + 0
        ),
        1
    )
)

measures.name: Distinct Saturdays
measures.expression:
VAR MinDate = CALCULATE(MIN(Data[Reporting Date]), ALLSELECTED(Data))
VAR MaxDate = CALCULATE(MAX(Data[Reporting Date]), ALLSELECTED(Data))
VAR AllDates = CALENDAR(MinDate, MaxDate)
VAR Result = 
    COUNTROWS(
        FILTER(
            AllDates,
            WEEKDAY([Date], 2) = 6  // Saturday=6 (when Monday=1)
        )
    )
RETURN Result

measures.name: Recommended Nurses / Hour (by Customer)
measures.expression:
VAR IsCell =
    ISINSCOPE('Data'[Customer Name]) && ISINSCOPE('Data'[Hour])
VAR IsRowSubtotal =
    ISINSCOPE('Data'[Customer Name]) && NOT ISINSCOPE('Data'[Hour])
VAR IsColSubtotal =
    NOT ISINSCOPE('Data'[Customer Name]) && ISINSCOPE('Data'[Hour])
VAR Divisor = 
    VAR Selected = SELECTEDVALUE('Nurse Call / Hour Goal'[Nurse Call / Hour Goal])
    RETURN IF(ISBLANK(Selected), 5, Selected)
VAR RoundingThreshold = [Selected Rounding Threshold]
RETURN
SWITCH(
    TRUE(),
    /* Body cells - NO rounding, just raw calculation */
    IsCell,
        VAR AvgContacts = [Calls / Shift / hr]
        VAR CalcValue = AvgContacts / Divisor
        VAR Result =
            IF(
                ISBLANK(AvgContacts),
                BLANK(),
                CalcValue  -- No rounding at all
            )
        RETURN Result,
    /* Row subtotal - Sum raw values, then apply rounding rules */
    IsRowSubtotal,
        VAR SumResult = SUMX(
            VALUES('Data'[Hour]),
            VAR AvgContacts = [Calls / Shift / hr]
            VAR CalcValue = AvgContacts / Divisor
            RETURN
                IF(
                    ISBLANK(AvgContacts),
                    BLANK(),
                    CalcValue  -- Sum unrounded values
                )
        )
        VAR WholeNumber = INT(SumResult)
        VAR DecimalPart = SumResult - WholeNumber
        VAR RoundedValue = 
            IF(
                DecimalPart >= RoundingThreshold,
                WholeNumber + 1,
                WholeNumber
            )
        RETURN RoundedValue,
    /* Column subtotal - Sum raw values, then apply rounding rules */
    IsColSubtotal,
        VAR SumResult = SUMX(
            VALUES('Data'[Customer Name]),
            VAR AvgContacts = CALCULATE([Calls / Shift / hr])
            VAR CalcValue = AvgContacts / Divisor
            RETURN
                IF(
                    ISBLANK(AvgContacts),
                    BLANK(),
                    CalcValue  -- Sum unrounded values
                )
        )
        VAR WholeNumber = INT(SumResult)
        VAR DecimalPart = SumResult - WholeNumber
        VAR RoundedValue = 
            IF(
                DecimalPart >= RoundingThreshold,
                WholeNumber + 1,
                WholeNumber
            )
        RETURN RoundedValue,
    /* Grand total - Sum raw values, then apply rounding rules with floor of 1 */
    VAR SumResult = SUMX(
        CROSSJOIN( VALUES('Data'[Customer Name]), VALUES('Data'[Hour]) ),
        VAR AvgContacts = CALCULATE([Calls / Shift / hr])
        VAR CalcValue = AvgContacts / Divisor
        RETURN
            IF(
                ISBLANK(AvgContacts),
                BLANK(),
                CalcValue  -- Sum unrounded values
            )
    )
    VAR WholeNumber = INT(SumResult)
    VAR DecimalPart = SumResult - WholeNumber
    VAR RoundedValue = 
        IF(
            DecimalPart >= RoundingThreshold,
            WholeNumber + 1,
            WholeNumber
        )
    RETURN MAX(RoundedValue, 1)  -- Floor of 1 for grand total
)

measures.name: Selected Divisor
measures.expression:
VAR SelectedValue = SELECTEDVALUE('Nurse Call / Hour Goal'[Nurse Call / Hour Goal])
RETURN
    IF(
        ISBLANK(SelectedValue),
        5,  -- Default divisor if nothing selected
        SelectedValue
    )

measures.name: Selected Rounding Threshold
measures.expression:
VAR SelectedThreshold = SELECTEDVALUE('Rounding Threshold'[Threshold Value])
RETURN
    IF(
        ISBLANK(SelectedThreshold),
        0.5,  -- Default to normal rounding if nothing selected
        SelectedThreshold
    )

measures.name: Test Rounding Logic
measures.expression:
VAR Divisor = 
    VAR Selected = SELECTEDVALUE('Nurse Call / Hour Goal'[Nurse Call / Hour Goal])
    RETURN IF(ISBLANK(Selected), 5, Selected)
VAR RoundingThreshold = [Selected Rounding Threshold]
VAR AvgContacts = [Calls / Shift / hr (sandbox)]
VAR CalcValue = AvgContacts / Divisor
VAR WholeNumber = INT(CalcValue)
VAR DecimalPart = CalcValue - WholeNumber
VAR RoundedValue = 
    IF(
        DecimalPart >= RoundingThreshold,
        WholeNumber + 1,
        WholeNumber + ROUND(DecimalPart, 1)
    )
RETURN
    "Avg: " & AvgContacts & 
    " | Calc: " & CalcValue & 
    " | Decimal: " & DecimalPart & 
    " | Threshold: " & RoundingThreshold & 
    " | Result: " & RoundedValue

measures.name: Avg Distinct Nurses (DEBUG - Multi-Team Count)
measures.expression:
VAR CurrentHour = SELECTEDVALUE(Data[Hour])

RETURN
IF(
    NOT ISBLANK(SELECTEDVALUE(Data[Team])),
    AVERAGEX(
        VALUES(Data[Reporting Date]),
        VAR CurrentDate = Data[Reporting Date]
        // Count how many nurses worked MULTIPLE teams this hour/date
        VAR MultiTeamNurses = 
            COUNTROWS(
                FILTER(
                    ALL(Data[Contact Agent Name]),
                    VAR NurseTeamCount = 
                        CALCULATE(
                            DISTINCTCOUNT(Data[Team]),
                            Data[Contact Agent Name] = EARLIER(Data[Contact Agent Name]),
                            Data[Reporting Date] = CurrentDate,
                            Data[Hour] = CurrentHour,
                            Data[Conatins ROQ?] = "N",
                            ALLSELECTED(Data[Team])
                        )
                    RETURN NurseTeamCount > 1
                )
            )
        RETURN MultiTeamNurses
    ),
    BLANK()
)

measures.name: Nurse FTE by Team-Hour
measures.expression:
VAR CurrentHour = SELECTEDVALUE(Data[Hour])
VAR CurrentTeam = SELECTEDVALUE(Data[Team])
VAR SelectedNurse = SELECTEDVALUE(Data[Contact Agent Name])

RETURN
SWITCH(
    TRUE(),
    
    // Single nurse selected - show their FTE allocation
    NOT ISBLANK(SelectedNurse) && NOT ISBLANK(CurrentTeam),
        VAR NurseCallsThisTeam = 
            CALCULATE(
                COUNT(Data[Contact ID]),
                Data[Contact Agent Name] = SelectedNurse,
                Data[Hour] = CurrentHour,
                Data[Team] = CurrentTeam
            )
        VAR NurseCallsAllTeams = 
            CALCULATE(
                COUNT(Data[Contact ID]),
                Data[Contact Agent Name] = SelectedNurse,
                Data[Hour] = CurrentHour,
                ALL(Data[Team])
            )
        RETURN DIVIDE(NurseCallsThisTeam, NurseCallsAllTeams, 0),
    
    // Team level - weighted FTE allocation
    NOT ISBLANK(CurrentTeam),
        SUMX(
            VALUES(Data[Reporting Date]),
            VAR CurrentDate = Data[Reporting Date]
            VAR DailyWeightedFTE = 
                SUMX(
                    FILTER(
                        ALL(Data[Contact Agent Name]),
                        CALCULATE(
                            COUNT(Data[Contact ID]),
                            Data[Reporting Date] = CurrentDate,
                            Data[Hour] = CurrentHour,
                            Data[Team] = CurrentTeam
                        ) > 0
                    ),
                    VAR CurrentNurse = Data[Contact Agent Name]
                    VAR NurseCallsThisTeam = 
                        CALCULATE(
                            COUNT(Data[Contact ID]),
                            Data[Contact Agent Name] = CurrentNurse,
                            Data[Reporting Date] = CurrentDate,
                            Data[Hour] = CurrentHour,
                            Data[Team] = CurrentTeam,
                            ALL(Data[Team])
                        )
                    VAR NurseCallsAllTeams = 
                        CALCULATE(
                            COUNT(Data[Contact ID]),
                            Data[Contact Agent Name] = CurrentNurse,
                            Data[Reporting Date] = CurrentDate,
                            Data[Hour] = CurrentHour,
                            ALL(Data[Team])
                        )
                    RETURN DIVIDE(NurseCallsThisTeam, NurseCallsAllTeams, 0)
                )
            RETURN DailyWeightedFTE
        ) / COUNTROWS(VALUES(Data[Reporting Date])),
    
    // Grand Total - sum team calculations by iterating teams
    SUMX(
        VALUES(Data[Team]),
        VAR TeamContext = Data[Team]
        VAR TeamFTE = 
            CALCULATE(
                SUMX(
                    VALUES(Data[Reporting Date]),
                    VAR CurrentDate = Data[Reporting Date]
                    VAR DailyWeightedFTE = 
                        SUMX(
                            FILTER(
                                ALL(Data[Contact Agent Name]),
                                CALCULATE(
                                    COUNT(Data[Contact ID]),
                                    Data[Reporting Date] = CurrentDate,
                                    Data[Hour] = CurrentHour,
                                    Data[Team] = TeamContext
                                ) > 0
                            ),
                            VAR CurrentNurse = Data[Contact Agent Name]
                            VAR NurseCallsThisTeam = 
                                CALCULATE(
                                    COUNT(Data[Contact ID]),
                                    Data[Contact Agent Name] = CurrentNurse,
                                    Data[Reporting Date] = CurrentDate,
                                    Data[Hour] = CurrentHour,
                                    Data[Team] = TeamContext,
                                    ALL(Data[Team])
                                )
                            VAR NurseCallsAllTeams = 
                                CALCULATE(
                                    COUNT(Data[Contact ID]),
                                    Data[Contact Agent Name] = CurrentNurse,
                                    Data[Reporting Date] = CurrentDate,
                                    Data[Hour] = CurrentHour,
                                    ALL(Data[Team])
                                )
                            RETURN DIVIDE(NurseCallsThisTeam, NurseCallsAllTeams, 0)
                        )
                    RETURN DailyWeightedFTE
                ) / COUNTROWS(VALUES(Data[Reporting Date])),
                Data[Team] = TeamContext
            )
        RETURN TeamFTE
    )
)

measures.name: Calls Per Nurse Per Hour
measures.expression: DIVIDE([Calls / Shift / hr], [Nurse FTE by Team-Hour (15Min Precision)], BLANK())

measures.name: Nurse FTE by Team-Hour (15Min Precision)
measures.expression:
VAR CurrentHour = SELECTEDVALUE(Data[Hour])
VAR CurrentTeam = SELECTEDVALUE(Data[Team])
VAR SelectedNurse = SELECTEDVALUE(Data[Contact Agent Name])

// Get all 15-min blocks that belong to this hour
VAR TimeBlocksInHour = 
    CALCULATETABLE(
        VALUES(Data[Time of Day]),
        Data[Hour] = CurrentHour
    )

RETURN
SWITCH(
    TRUE(),
    
    // Single nurse selected - average their FTE across 15-min blocks in this hour
    NOT ISBLANK(SelectedNurse) && NOT ISBLANK(CurrentTeam),
        AVERAGEX(
            TimeBlocksInHour,
            VAR CurrentTimeBlock = Data[Time of Day]
            VAR NurseCallsThisTeam = 
                CALCULATE(
                    COUNT(Data[Contact ID]),
                    Data[Contact Agent Name] = SelectedNurse,
                    Data[Time of Day] = CurrentTimeBlock,
                    Data[Team] = CurrentTeam
                )
            VAR NurseCallsAllTeams = 
                CALCULATE(
                    COUNT(Data[Contact ID]),
                    Data[Contact Agent Name] = SelectedNurse,
                    Data[Time of Day] = CurrentTimeBlock,
                    ALL(Data[Team])
                )
            RETURN DIVIDE(NurseCallsThisTeam, NurseCallsAllTeams, 0)
        ),
    
    // Team level - weighted FTE allocation averaged across 15-min blocks
    NOT ISBLANK(CurrentTeam),
        AVERAGEX(
            TimeBlocksInHour,
            VAR CurrentTimeBlock = Data[Time of Day]
            VAR BlockFTE = 
                SUMX(
                    VALUES(Data[Reporting Date]),
                    VAR CurrentDate = Data[Reporting Date]
                    VAR DailyWeightedFTE = 
                        SUMX(
                            FILTER(
                                ALL(Data[Contact Agent Name]),
                                CALCULATE(
                                    COUNT(Data[Contact ID]),
                                    Data[Reporting Date] = CurrentDate,
                                    Data[Time of Day] = CurrentTimeBlock,
                                    Data[Team] = CurrentTeam
                                ) > 0
                            ),
                            VAR CurrentNurse = Data[Contact Agent Name]
                            VAR NurseCallsThisTeam = 
                                CALCULATE(
                                    COUNT(Data[Contact ID]),
                                    Data[Contact Agent Name] = CurrentNurse,
                                    Data[Reporting Date] = CurrentDate,
                                    Data[Time of Day] = CurrentTimeBlock,
                                    Data[Team] = CurrentTeam,
                                    ALL(Data[Team])
                                )
                            VAR NurseCallsAllTeams = 
                                CALCULATE(
                                    COUNT(Data[Contact ID]),
                                    Data[Contact Agent Name] = CurrentNurse,
                                    Data[Reporting Date] = CurrentDate,
                                    Data[Time of Day] = CurrentTimeBlock,
                                    ALL(Data[Team])
                                )
                            RETURN DIVIDE(NurseCallsThisTeam, NurseCallsAllTeams, 0)
                        )
                    RETURN DailyWeightedFTE
                ) / COUNTROWS(VALUES(Data[Reporting Date]))
            RETURN BlockFTE
        ),
    
    // Grand Total - sum team calculations across 15-min blocks
    AVERAGEX(
        TimeBlocksInHour,
        VAR CurrentTimeBlock = Data[Time of Day]
        VAR BlockFTE = 
            SUMX(
                VALUES(Data[Team]),
                VAR TeamContext = Data[Team]
                VAR TeamFTE = 
                    CALCULATE(
                        SUMX(
                            VALUES(Data[Reporting Date]),
                            VAR CurrentDate = Data[Reporting Date]
                            VAR DailyWeightedFTE = 
                                SUMX(
                                    FILTER(
                                        ALL(Data[Contact Agent Name]),
                                        CALCULATE(
                                            COUNT(Data[Contact ID]),
                                            Data[Reporting Date] = CurrentDate,
                                            Data[Time of Day] = CurrentTimeBlock,
                                            Data[Team] = TeamContext
                                        ) > 0
                                    ),
                                    VAR CurrentNurse = Data[Contact Agent Name]
                                    VAR NurseCallsThisTeam = 
                                        CALCULATE(
                                            COUNT(Data[Contact ID]),
                                            Data[Contact Agent Name] = CurrentNurse,
                                            Data[Reporting Date] = CurrentDate,
                                            Data[Time of Day] = CurrentTimeBlock,
                                            Data[Team] = TeamContext,
                                            ALL(Data[Team])
                                        )
                                    VAR NurseCallsAllTeams = 
                                        CALCULATE(
                                            COUNT(Data[Contact ID]),
                                            Data[Contact Agent Name] = CurrentNurse,
                                            Data[Reporting Date] = CurrentDate,
                                            Data[Time of Day] = CurrentTimeBlock,
                                            ALL(Data[Team])
                                        )
                                    RETURN DIVIDE(NurseCallsThisTeam, NurseCallsAllTeams, 0)
                                )
                            RETURN DailyWeightedFTE
                        ) / COUNTROWS(VALUES(Data[Reporting Date])),
                        Data[Team] = TeamContext
                    )
                RETURN TeamFTE
            )
        RETURN BlockFTE
    )
)
